assets.name: long-beaked-orange-winged-bird
assets.description: A long-beaked green-gray bird with two orange wings, orange legs and an attached human-headed tail. Part of the Walters W.82 Marginalia set.

provenance.title: Initial "S" with dying man receiving last rites from abbot; woman dances on shoulder of bagpipe player in margin

extraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the referenced ORIGINAL historical manuscript detail. Make a faithful transparent cutout of ONLY the specified complete painted subject. Keep the original pose, proportions, colors, hand-drawn contours and slight scan softness. Preserve every actual limb, prop and delicate painted stroke; do not invent missing parts or new detail. Opaque pale skin/eyes/painted surfaces stay opaque; genuine gaps between limbs and props and around the subject are transparent. Remove all parchment, text, foliate manuscript borders, unrelated neighbor figures, isolated marks and stains. Smooth fine antialiased edges; no coarse binary steps, polygon outlines, paper fringe, black ground line, shadow, sharpened modern cartoon or extra texture. Preserve the original figure aspect and its relative anatomy. Subject: ONE complete green-gray hybrid dragon with a very long toothed horizontal bird beak facing LEFT, long green curling neck, original small dark eye and crest, gray-green rounded body, BOTH orange feathered wings stretched outward/upward, its two original long orange legs and toes below, and the pale curly HUMAN-HEADED tail attached behind the right wing at the lower right. That human head is part of the same original beast; keep its eyes, curls, mouth and beard/skin as painted and all the connecting tail. Preserve BOTH orange wings and their narrow feather tips. The body is not just its green portion; orange wings/legs and pale tail-face also belong to the cutout. Exclude the separate orange flower/foliate stem at left, the blue/red/gold border underneath/behind it and the text above. No simplified wings, missing orange parts, new tail, added body or ground line.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.
extraction.subject_resolution_cap_method: Both subject axes capped to inspected native subject bounds; input-region whitespace cannot permit subject upscaling.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

review.approval_scope: Extraction-workflow visual review only; remains provisional for maintainer review.
review.notes: Checked the full long beak, green-gray neck and body, both orange wings, both orange feet and toes, and the attached human-headed tail behind the right wing. Pale tail face remains opaque. Removed the nearby separate flower/stem, text and painted border; transparent openings follow the spaces between the original limbs and wings. Built-in image_gen extraction: approximate source texture, tones and small contours are explicitly recorded; no native subject upscaling and no forced SVG redraw.
maintainer_identification: Maintainer identified this hybrid as a bird, not a dragon.

assets.usage_notes: Original source and exact AI extraction prompt retained. This is an AI-assisted approximation, not a pixel-exact crop; minute contours, scan grain and tones can differ. No separately split versions of contacting figures/props. Native subject bounds cap both axes, with no raster upscaling.
